blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Zamboanga City Mayor Khymer Olaso has offered a P2-million cash reward for credible information leading to the identification and arrest of the gunmen behind the deadly attack on an Isabela City judge in Barangay Tumaga, Zamboanga City early Thursday morning. Speaking at a press briefing at City Hall late Thursday afternoon, Olaso strongly condemned the killing of Isabela City Regional Trial Court Judge Joseph Wee Sit, who was gunned down in Barangay Tumaga. “This senseless act of violence is deeply disturbing and has no place in a city that values peace, justice, and the rule […]...
